prediction_text: Prince Rupert shall get NO honour by these wars, nor worst the Earl of Essex; Essex has the better of him. Rupert, signified by the 10th house and its lord the Sun, is peregrine and in his detriment in a fixed sign — no dignity, no fortune in command. Essex is signified by Venus, lady of the opposite house, who is in reception with Saturn and disposes of Rupert's own significator — Essex's party holds Rupert's fortune in their hands; Venus also casts a dexter aspect to the cusp of the 10th, while the Moon casts her sinister aspect to the same cusp against Rupert. What becomes of him: his enterprises in this war decline into loss of honour; he is worsted by Essex's side and his reputation sinks the longer the war continues (campaign-scale: over the following campaigns/seasons).
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：Rupert能否得荣誉／制Essex（主问）、其结局如何（续问）。断项过闸：不得荣誉反被制←Rupert象征太阳无定位陷宫固定无力＋Essex象征金星与土星互容且支配Rupert象征星、吉相临十宫头；月亮左相临十宫头为其逆证。对象核：两方象征分栏作断、未混同。应期定战役尺度（月/年之间偏月档），无具体成相度数、不落单日。
